rows.en:
A Challenge!
I challenge you to a duel today at Griffith Park!!
Face me, and do not run away!!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. frd_yui_008; her message (hatashijou, a formal challenge letter).

rows.en:
P.S.
I'll be waiting until you come,
so you'd better show up!!!

(After getting a message like that,
I can hardly not show up...)

Heh heh heh heh!
I've been expecting you! You did well not to run!!
Well, after getting a message like that...

I summoned you here today, knave,
for one reason alone! There is something
I simply must tell you!!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, male scene. Mock-duel diction (kisama) rendered as "knave".

rows.en: Uh... I see......

Oh, come on! Where's your energy~?
And here I am, mustering up
all my courage and trying so hard~!
I don't really get it, but sorry...

(I think it's just that Hoshimura's
energy is way too high...)

Come on, you've gotta get it together.
Okay, I'm starting over from the top!
(Oh, she has to start over...)
Uh, okay......

I can't do it!
At least today, I'm in no state to say it!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, male scene. Her restart is not a row here; she gives up.

rows.en:
Once again, I don't really get it,
but I'm sorry......

I lose this duel~!
Boil me, roast me, do with me as you will~!!

Um, so in the end, what were you
trying to say, Hoshimura?

Well, to put it simply...
What I wanted to say is that I want us
to keep being close from here on, see.
Oh, is that all? Of course we will.
Really!? You really mean that?
Yeah, of course.

...Well, I guess that'll do for today.
Yeah, I'll just leave it at that.
(She seems to have settled it all on her own...)

Phew~ Now that I've relaxed, I'm starving.
I know! Let's go eat steak and pineapple salad~!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, male scene. Steak and pineapple salad as c14102.

rows.en:
That's out of nowhere, as usual.
Oh well, let's go.
What! Why!?
rows.notes: Player, both genders. Reacts to being made to pay (her line is not in this slice); as c14208.

rows.en:
...Call it punishment for toying with
a maiden's feelings, or whatever...

Anyway, you HAVE to treat me!
Understood?
I don't really get it, but understood...

Very well, then!
Alll right, away we gooo!!
Yeah, yeah, away we go!!

(Haaah... The steak's really gonna hurt
my wallet, but if it cheers Hoshimura up,
I guess that's fine.)

(After all, a Hoshimura without her energy
just isn't Hoshimura.)

(Yeah! Here's to many more good times
with you, Hoshimura.)

(After getting a message like that,
I can hardly not show up...)

I summoned you here today, knave,
for one reason alone! There is something
I simply must tell you!!
Uh... I see......
I don't really get it, but sorry...

(I think it's just that Yui's
energy is way too high...)

Eh, whatever. Joking aside,
thanks a lot for coming today.
No, thank you for inviting me.

Like I said, I called you out here because
there's something I really have to tell you.
Something to tell me...?
Yeah... Um, well, uh... Okay!
Please keep being close with me from now on!!
Huh? Well, of course I will.
Of course I do. That goes without saying.
rows.notes: Female; answers the shared "Really!? You really mean that?" (c14593).

rows.en: I see... Yeah... Thank you......

Y'know, 'cause I'm always so hyper,
people sometimes kinda avoid me...

But you stick around with someone like me,
and hanging out with you is so much fun,
so I got a little too carried away.

Haaah~, I'm so relieved~
Now that I've relaxed, I'm getting hungry~
Then want to go eat steak and pineapple salad?
Sounds great. Your treat, of course, right?
For toying with an innocent maiden's feelings.
rows.notes: Hoshimura, female scene. Answers the player's "Why?" (c14599).

rows.en: Ehhh~ What's that supposed to mean?
Hehe, alll right, away we gooo!!
Geez, you're impossible...

(Haaah... The steak's really gonna hurt
my wallet, but if it cheers Yui up,
I guess that's okay.)

(After all, a Yui without her energy
just isn't Yui.)

(Yeah! Here's to many more good times
with you, Yui.)

And then! And then!
Miyuki, she...
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. frd_yui_008 second visit; Miyuki = Miyuki Shirakawa.

rows.en: Wow~ So that happened, huh.

(Walking home from school chatting
with Hoshimura like this really is fun.)

...Totally changing the subject, but don't
you feel like right now we're, like,
'totally living our youth to the max!'?
Huh? What do you mean?
What! You don't get it?

C'mon, get it~
It's you and me we're talking about,
so get it, even if you have to fake it~
S-sorry...

...Like, talking and goofing around together
like this on the way home is super fun!
That's what I mean!!

I see.
You might be right...
Very well, so long as you understand!
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. (wakatta no nara yoroshii); cf. c14144.

rows.en: So, back to what I was saying, actually Yuu also...
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. Yuu = Yuu Akimizu (bare given name, as c00625).

rows.en:
(Yeah, just like Hoshimura says,
maybe this is what they call youth.)

Geez, \p!
Are you even listening to me?
Of course I'm listening.

(I hope peaceful days like these
keep going on from here.)

(Walking home from school chatting
with Yui like this really is fun.)

(Yeah, just like Yui says,
maybe this is what they call youth.)
Of course I'm listening.

(I hope peaceful days like these
keep going on from here.)

uncertain: c14599 (x2): in the male scene no 'your treat' line from Yui precedes the player's 'What! Why!?' (female has c14626); translated as the reaction to being made to pay.
